question: How do we get a marriage licence?

nuggets.text: Marriage licences are issued by the clerk or deputy clerk of a circuit court.
nuggets.quote: Every license for a marriage shall be issued by the clerk or deputy clerk of a circuit court of any county or city.

nuggets.text: A $20 licence tax is collected by the clerk when the licence is issued.
nuggets.quote: On each marriage license issued under § 20-14 there is hereby levied a license tax of $20, which tax shall be collected by the clerk when the license is issued and accounted for as in the case of other state taxes collected by him.

nuggets.text: A licence is required before the marriage is solemnised.
nuggets.quote: Every license for a marriage shall be issued by the clerk or deputy clerk of a circuit court of any county or city.

nuggets.text: In Charlottesville the Clerk of the Circuit Court issues it.
nuggets.quote: Clerk of the Charlottesville Circuit Court (constitutional officer)
